youtube_description:
Hey everyone, I am back with another debrief on the Australian GP from Sunday, April 10th, at the Melbourne Grand Prix Circuit! The time difference through me a little out of the loop. But, I still managed to check in and watch the race. With Ferrari and Charles Leclerc clinching first place, followed by Red Bull securing second place, I am ready to see what Mercedes can do to pull it together. I'm also excited about the upcoming Emilia Romagna Grand Prix and "what it means" for the remainder of the season.
